clues.title: Vehicle registration
clues.flavor: Glove compartment. This car is registered to Elena Voss.

clues.title: Tire tread
clues.flavor: Same narrow-set compact tread as the alley tracks behind the gallery.

clues.title: Pair of thin gloves
clues.flavor: Tucked in the door pocket. No blood, but no reason for a gallery director to carry these either.

clues.title: Parking receipt
clues.flavor: Timestamped 11:47pm the night of the murder - well after Elena claimed she'd already gone home.

clues.title: Engraved lighter
clues.flavor: Initials 'E.V.' Used, from the look of the flint wear, more than once that week.
